description:
Rakhi making workshop:
Rakhi Making Workshop at Pandurang Vidyalaya and Shrinagar Vidyamandir on 22/08/2026.
It was organized in collaboration with Pryavaran Dakshta Mandal, Thane. The rakhis were made from the environment friendly materials.
There were 70 students at Shrinagar Vidyamandir participated in the workshop around 20 students from Pandurang Vidyalaya participated in the workshop.
President Rtn. Vinod Chaube and Jt. Secretary Rtn. Kailas Satanekar were present at Shrinagar Vidyamandir
Rtn. Rajnikant Parikh, Rtn. Ajay Parikh and Secretary Rtn. KV Natarajan were present at Pandurang Vidyalaya.
The workshop was published in the Marathi Daily Sakal on 23/08/2026. The founder of the school Ms. Padmavati Patil along with Principal and other staff of the school were present at the workshop.
